note: Set from the reference run in docs/benchmarks/baseline.json with wide headroom. These catch a major regression — a stream that starts shedding, stalling, or losing frames — not a few milliseconds. A slower CI runner should still pass; if one does not, read the artifact before moving a limit.

runToRunTolerance.note: Two back-to-back runs of one build must agree within this, or the measurement is too noisy to regress against.
